Location Name: Gài Yâang Rá Bìiap (grilled chicken and som tum)
Location Name ZH: Gài Yâang Rá Bìiap 烤雞青木瓜沙拉
Notes:
Gai Yang Rabeab (ไก่ย่างระเบียบ) — a top choice in the city! Highly praised by food lovers as the “pinnacle of grilled chicken.”

If you do not want to make a special trip north to Khao Suan Kwang District, this legendary restaurant near central Khon Kaen is the perfect alternative. The owner’s family comes from Khao Suan Kwang itself, and the high-quality free-range chickens used by the chain are delivered fresh from their place of origin every day.

What makes it unique: The restaurant uses a carefully designed “half-grilled, half-roasted” setup that combines a special metal basin with a traditional clay charcoal stove. This slow, indirect charcoal-roasting method allows the heat to circulate evenly. The chicken comes out with perfectly golden, thin, crisp skin, while the meat underneath stays moist and tender with an almost silky richness, showcasing the pure flavor of quality free-range chicken without excessive seasoning.

(It is recommended to arrive before 3:00 PM in case it sells out.)
Notes ZH:
Gai Yang Rabeab (ไก่ย่างระเบียบ) —— 市區首選！美食家激推的「烤雞天花板」

如果你不想特地跑到北邊的考宣光縣，這家開在孔敬市中心附近的傳奇名店就是你的完美解方。它的店主家族正是來自考宣光本郡，連鎖店所使用的優質土雞也是每天從原產地新鮮運送過來。

獨特之處： 這家店的烤法非常考究，使用的是一種結合了特製金屬盆與傳統黏土小火爐的「半烤半烘」特殊構造。這種慢火間接炭烤的方式，能讓炭火熱度完美地在空間中迴流。烤出來的雞皮呈現極致完美的金黃色，質地薄脆，而皮下的肉質濕潤、細嫩，甚至帶有一種近乎滑順的油脂感，完美呈現了優質走地雞純粹、無添加過多醬料的鮮美原味。

（建議下午三點前入店以免售罄）

Notes:
Ton Tann creative night market.

Highlight: Rather than a traditional crowded local food center, this is a green, creative night market laid out like a park. In addition to neatly arranged stalls selling clothes and handicrafts, there are tempting Thai foods such as Isan grilled meats and som tum. Local bands and street performers often play live on the central stage.
—
Khon Kaen 📍Ton Tann Market
We returned from Kalasin to find food at this Khon Kaen night market. It is quite large and lively even on weekdays, with lots of snacks. The environment was cleaner than expected, and staff were assigned to clear the tables 👌🏻
At a 🥥 น้ำหวานผลไม้ fruit drink shop, we ordered a coconut milk smoothie. It was delicious and highly recommended, and cost only 35 baht. We also asked the owner to recommend a good stall, and they enthusiastically pointed us to Tam Loei across the way, which serves Thai spicy seafood salad. It was busy and the shrimp were very fresh—asking a local was definitely the right choice.
If you do not eat raw food, there are other northeastern Thai snacks in the market. It is a great place to fill up and browse around.
Notes ZH:
頓潭文創夜市（Ton Tann Market）

亮點：這不是傳統擁擠的在地熟食中心，而是一個充滿綠意、規劃得像公園一樣的文創夜市。現場除了鋪位整齊的衣服、手工藝品和令人垂涎的依善烤肉、青木瓜沙拉等泰國小吃外，中央大舞台經常有在地樂團或街頭藝人 Live 演出。
—
孔敬📍Ton tann market
從加拉信回到孔敬夜市覓食 規模滿大的就算是平日也很熱鬧 小吃很多 原本擔心的環境也很乾淨 也有專人清理餐桌👌🏻
有家🥥น้ำหวานผลไม้ (水果飲料店） 點了椰奶冰沙 超好喝！！超推只要35泰銖好便宜 順道請老闆推薦好吃的攤位 很熱心指了斜對面的ตำเลย (Tam Loei)泰式涼拌海鮮 生意很好 蝦子很新鮮 果然問在地人沒錯
